The '''De'nel system''' was an uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Brak Sector Force]] established a secret [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base in the system with one full [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].
